description: RFC 8620 §5.5 /query defines standard args anchor, anchorOffset, calculateTotal that metadata_query (src/methods/metadata.rs:173) does not expose. RFC 8620 §5.6 /queryChanges defines upToId, calculateTotal, sort, filter (filter/sort are mandatory to thread through the queryChanges side too so the server can deterministically reproduce the query) that metadata_query_changes (src/methods/metadata.rs:206) does not expose. Trigger: client paginating a Metadata listing via anchor-based pagination, or wanting the total count, has to bypass the typed builder. Also: workspace-wide — mail-client, chat-client, calendars-client all omit these. Fix proposal: rather than ballooning positional args, introduce MetadataQueryParams and MetadataQueryChangesParams (per the bead above) and thread anchor/anchorOffset/calculateTotal/upToId/etc. through those. This is the same shape that PLAN.md's New-type rule contemplates. Workspace-wide propagation needed; canonical mail-client should land the pattern first.
title: metadata_query / metadata_query_changes: missing RFC 8620 §5.5/§5.6 standard args
